maya: Heads-up — spike idea: use 'batch leases' to own ranges of prefixes for prefetching and eviction. Goal is to reduce per-prefix RPCs and eviction churn. Suggestion: acquire lease for a small shard of prefixes (N≈50), attach an epoch and batch_id, and renew on hot touches. Eviction becomes batch-TTL driven rather than per-prefix; soft demote still supported.

liam: Can you clarify tradeoffs? how do we do fairness between tenants and avoid a single node hoarding hot prefixes? :thinking:

maya: Good Q. Tradeoffs:
- Pro: fewer lease ops, less metadata churn on hot bursts.
- Con: coarser granularity could hurt fairness for mixed-tenant hosts.
Approach: use adaptive batch size tied to tenant weight + hotness score, and admission control on acquire. If a batch crosses tenant boundaries we split ownership by tenant priority.

sanjay: Concern: takeover correctness. If node A holds batch lease and crashes after adding prefixes to local cache, someone else must be able to reclaim and see a consistent view. We need a lease epoch + persistent fence so takeover doesn't see partial writes. Also read-after-write for in-flight writes must not be lost.

maya: Agreed. Implementation sketch:
```
lease = {batch_id, epoch, owner, prefixes[], expires_at}
on acquire: compare(epoch), write-lease-to-store(lease)
on takeover: increment epoch, transfer ownership, invalidate local KV with fence=epoch
on read: accept local cache only if fence <= lease.epoch
```
This keeps takeover idempotent and gives a clear fence for reads.

liam: What about eviction interaction? If we evict by batch TTL we might remove cold prefixes that another node still expects. Need a grace window and a 'soft pin' api for in-flight RPCs.

maya: Exactly — plan is soft pin per-prefix with short TTL for active requests; batch eviction only removes unpinned prefixes. We'll add metrics: eviction_mismatch_rate, takeover_latency_ms, stale_prefix_count.

evie-bot: Canary build deployed: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/prefetch-batch-lease-rc1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: canary 2026-03-21T15:12:03Z - ok - 3/3 nodes healthy :white_check_mark:

sanjay: Also propose a backward-compatible flag: runtime.enable_batch_leases=false so we can roll out per-cluster. Experiment plan: small cluster with hotset-synthetic workload, compare lease-op QPS, prefix rehydrate rate, and tail latency.

maya: I'll write a short RFC follow-up with interface sketches, metrics, and a micro-experiment. If folks agree, I'll spin up the canary and tag @sanjay for correctness review. :+1:

liam: Sounds good. please include an escape hatch for tenant fairness (max prefixes per-tenant per-host) and a dashboard query for 'batch_steal_attempts'.

maya: Will do. Thanks!
